widgets.name: AdGuard Home
widgets.description: AdGuard Home DNS stats — queries and % blocked (uses your AdGuard login).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Sonarr / Radarr / Lidarr
widgets.description: Download queue for a *arr app (Sonarr, Radarr or Lidarr). Needs URL + API key.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Bookmarks
widgets.description: A grid of quick links. One per line: Label|https://url
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Clock
widgets.description: Local (or any time zone) clock with date, updating every second. A producer-less example widget — supports multiple independent instances.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Crypto Ticker
widgets.description: Prices + 24h change for coins (CoinGecko, keyless). Use CoinGecko ids.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Custom API
widgets.description: Fetch any JSON API and show chosen fields. Map 'Label: path.to.value' per line.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Downloads
widgets.description: Active downloads on qBittorrent (login) or SABnzbd (API key).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Frigate
widgets.description: Frigate NVR — cameras and per-camera detection FPS.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Frigate Camera
widgets.description: Live Frigate cameras — auto-refreshing snapshots or a continuous MJPEG stream. One or more camera names.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: GitHub Repo
widgets.description: Stars, issues and forks for a GitHub repository (owner/name).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: GPU Monitor
widgets.description: NVIDIA GPU monitor — VRAM, clock, power, temperature and a selectable fan, each with a live history graph. Supports multiple GPUs and fans.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Home Assistant
widgets.description: States of chosen Home Assistant entities. Needs the HA URL + a long-lived access token. (The Hub container must be able to reach your HA instance.)
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: HTTP Endpoint
widgets.description: Monitor one endpoint: status code + a live response-time graph.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Image
widgets.description: Show any image URL (proxied same-origin to avoid mixed-content/CORS). Optionally auto-refresh — e.g. a webcam/MJPEG snapshot URL.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: LocalAI
widgets.description: Models available on a LocalAI / OpenAI-compatible server.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Media Server
widgets.description: Now-playing sessions on Plex, Jellyfin or Emby. Needs URL + token/API key.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Network Interfaces
widgets.description: Physical network interfaces and bonds: link state and negotiated link speed (not current throughput). Reads directly from the host over sysfs -- no configuration needed. Requires the /sys read-only mount in app-compose.yaml.
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Pi-hole
widgets.description: Pi-hole DNS stats — queries and % blocked today (Pi-hole v5 API token).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Portainer
widgets.description: Container running/total count from a Portainer endpoint (API key).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Proxmox
widgets.description: VM/LXC running counts and statuses from Proxmox (API token).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Public IP
widgets.description: Your WAN IP address, ISP and location (via ip-api.com, keyless).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: RSS Feed
widgets.description: Latest headlines from one or more RSS/Atom feeds (one URL per line).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: SSL Certificates
widgets.description: Days until TLS certificates expire. One host per line (host or host:port).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Status Monitor
widgets.description: Up/down + latency for a list of services. One per line: Label|https://url
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Uptime Kuma
widgets.description: Monitor states from an Uptime Kuma status page (needs the status-page slug).
widgets.author: CW

widgets.name: Weather
widgets.description: Current conditions + 3-day forecast for a city (Open-Meteo, keyless).
widgets.author: CW
